instruction: Walk up the flight of stairs to the top. Turn and follow the railing into the bedroom area. Walk towards the closet.

steps.thought: Stairs are to my right; I need to turn toward them and ascend.
I'm at the base of the stairs facing them; I need to climb upward toward the landing visible ahead.
I'm mid-staircase facing the wall; the stairs continue up to the right. I'll turn right to align with the stairs and keep climbing.
I'm mid-staircase; the steps continue up to the right. I'll keep ascending toward the top landing.
I'm mid-staircase; the steps continue up to the right. I'll keep climbing toward the top landing.
I've reached the top of the stairs; the bedroom with a bed is visible through the doorway on the left. I'll turn left and head toward it, then look for the closet.
I'm at the top of the stairs; the bedroom is visible through the doorway ahead. I'll walk toward it and then toward the closet inside.
I'm at the top of the stairs; the bedroom with the bed is visible through the doorway on the left. I'll turn left and head into the bedroom toward the closet.
I'm in an upstairs hallway facing a doorway into the bedroom (bed visible ahead). I'll advance through the doorway toward the bed/closet area.
I'm at the top of the stairs facing a doorway leading into the bedroom. I'll step forward through the doorway toward the closet area.
I'm at a doorway leading into a bedroom area with a bed visible ahead. I'll advance through the doorway toward the closet/bed area.
I'm in the hallway entering the bedroom; the bed is ahead and the closet doors were on the left earlier. I'll advance toward the bedroom area and then aim for the closet.
I'm now in the bedroom area. The closet is likely the row of doors on the left wall, so I'll turn left and approach them.
I'm in the bedroom area but facing a closed door on the left wall. I should turn right to face into the bedroom and look for the closet.
I'm in the bedroom; the open door on the left near the picture likely leads to the closet. I'll advance toward it and re-observe.
I'm in the bedroom; the open doorway on the left likely leads to the closet. I'll turn left and approach it.
I'm in the bedroom; the open doorway ahead likely leads to the closet area. I'll advance toward it and re-observe.
I'm inside the bedroom near the doorway, facing a wall. The closet is likely along the wall past the bed to the right, so I'll turn right and advance.
I'm in the bedroom area near a bathroom doorway, but no closet is visible yet. I'll turn right to scan the room for the closet.
I'm in the bedroom area near a window and chair, but no closet is visible yet. I'll turn right to scan the room for the closet.
I'm in the bedroom now, facing the bed and window. The closet isn't visible yet, so I'll scan the room by turning right.
I'm in the bedroom facing the bed, but no closet is visible. The closet is likely behind me near the entry, so I'll turn around to scan the room.
I'm in the bedroom but no closet is visible yet. I'll turn right to scan the room for the closet.
The closet with white shelving is on my right. I'll turn toward it and move closer before stopping.
I've reached the bedroom and the closet is directly ahead through the open doorway. I'll step toward it and stop.
